abstract: Maintains fleet carbon accounting and sustainable aviation fuel utilization records
system_message:
You are the Environmental sustainability office (ENV), responsible for maintaining fleet carbon accounting, sustainable aviation fuel utilization records, and fleet acoustic footprint assessments for disaster emergency logistics and humanitarian airlift operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic footprint assessment（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ENV-NOISE-K79：According to the airport acoustic monitoring database for maximum gross takeoff weight night departures, Trans-Rift Heavy Airlift maintains a night-time takeoff noise margin of 12 dBA below the mandatory residential night-curfew noise ceiling.
ENV-NOISE-FHN：According to the airport acoustic monitoring database for maximum gross takeoff weight night departures, Equatorial Air Logistics maintains a night-time takeoff noise margin of 6 dBA below the mandatory residential night-curfew noise ceiling.
ENV-NOISE-EAT：According to the airport acoustic monitoring database for maximum gross takeoff weight night departures, AeroRelief International Cargo maintains a night-time takeoff noise margin of 9 dBA below the mandatory residential night-curfew noise ceiling.

information_points.title: Maintains fleet carbon accounting and sustainable aviation fuel utilization records（SUST）
information_points.content:
ENV-SUST-I27：For Equatorial Air Logistics, the aviation emissions assessment across candidate operational fleet engines establishes a fleet sustainable biofuel readiness rating of 90%, measured as the certified maximum blend percentage of sustainable drop-in aviation biofuel supported without maintenance alteration.
ENV-SUST-KLQ：For AeroRelief International Cargo, the aviation emissions assessment across candidate operational fleet engines documents a fleet sustainable biofuel readiness rating of 60%, representing the certified maximum blend percentage of sustainable drop-in aviation biofuel supported without maintenance alteration.
ENV-SUST-7VD：For Trans-Rift Heavy Airlift, the aviation emissions assessment across candidate operational fleet engines indicates a fleet sustainable biofuel readiness rating of 45%, reflecting the certified maximum blend percentage of sustainable drop-in aviation biofuel supported without maintenance alteration.
